arrive.text: A little town, on a still afternoon. You've a train to catch, at a quarter past two.

notice.text: Market day, Saturday. Choir practice, Thursday. A lost cat. Clock repairs, enquire within.

bench.text: A bench in the sun. The whole town seems to be having a nap.

reads.text: The town clock says two o'clock. It has always kept good time.

go.text: Just time to make your train, if you hurry.

station.text: About fifteen minutes after you started hurrying, you reach the station.

true.text: And the station clock says a quarter past two, on the dot. You made it.

night.text: The evening comes. Then the night. Then the morning.

stopped.text: The town clock never moved. It had stopped at two, the day before. You happened to look at it in one of the two minutes a day it's right.

end.text: You believed it. It was true. You had good reason, and you caught your train. So did you know what time it was?
